description: Native TensorFold Music3 CUDA engine from drowzeys/Imagination Studio, pinned at 8cd08c8350c02cf3d7d8eee5f1c1d9dfa22fa703. Generates a bounded 60-second stereo 44.1 kHz WAV from a caption and optional lyrics. The three Comfy-Org checkpoint files stay immutable; the engine makes int8 autoregressive weights on the GPU at load. 30 DiT steps, AR guidance 1.5, DiT guidance 1.7, seed 0. Upstream measured about 18 GB; 32 GB peak is an unqualified planning estimate including load and workspace. Physical Spark and audio-quality acceptance are pending. MiniMax-Music3 Community License terms are included.
title: MiniMax-Music3 TensorFold CUDA single Spark
